subject: English
question_text: Complete the passage using suitable connectors. 1  5 =
stimulus: The rapid growth of population must be controlled. (a) ⎯⎯ all sorts of attempts to solve food problem will fail. (b) ⎯⎯, we have to increase our food production very rapidly. We may mostly solve our food problem by changing our habit. (c) ⎯⎯ we can take potato instead of rice. (d) ⎯⎯ it is high time we changed our eating habit. (e) ⎯⎯, knowledge of nutritive value of food can help solve our food problem to a great extent.
guide_solution: Use of sentence connectors (a) Otherwise (b) Besides (c) For example (d) So (e) Moreover
